errors.error_description: Used an escaped identifier named after a SystemVerilog keyword (\always) as a signal, which is legal syntax but violates reserved word usage guidelines.
Used logical AND (&&) on 32-bit vectors to implement a bitwise AND operation, which collapses to a 1-bit boolean and silently misbehaves.
Implemented a deeply nested ternary conditional expression for one ALU operation, creating an excessively long combinational path.
